Author: Dalagab Group
Name: Omega
Description:
Find the plugin you want without hunting through repository lists. Omega brings official and community Dalamud plugins into one searchable storefront with Spotlight, screenshots, tags, compatibility, source choice, and Sigmascope evidence.

Use /omega or /omg to open Omega, compare repositories, inspect Sigmascope findings, install through Dalamud, and keep your Library and Updates together.
Changelog: Unreleased work build: repair Sigmascope Evidence v2 publication while preserving fail-closed validation and the 32 MiB publication ceiling. Final release notes are assigned when a GitHub tag is cut.
